    Buying flexi plywood in Kakinada

    Flexi plywood
    questions.

    For homeowners, carpenters, interior designers, architects and builders. Still unsure? Call or WhatsApp us and we will help you choose.

    What is flexi plywood?
    Flexi plywood is plywood engineered to bend into smooth curves without cracking. It is used for curved walls, columns, reception desks, arches and rounded furniture.
    Can I put laminate or veneer on flexi plywood?
    Yes. Flexi plywood is easy to fix and finish. Ask our team which laminate or veneer suits your curve.
    Does your flexi plywood come with a warranty?
    Yes. Liveteck flexi plywood comes with a lifetime warranty and a 100% Gurjan face veneer. Ask our team for the warranty details when you buy.
    How do I get flexi plywood prices?
